description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor' that extends 'AbstractStreamingActor'. It provides functionality for streaming persisted entity revisions within certain bounds, interfacing with MongoDB via 'MongoReadJournal', and including methods for creating data sources, managing timeouts, and message batching. It serves as a base class for actors dealing with streaming data related to persistence entities, likely within a distributed or reactive system context.

classes.name: AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor
classes.description: An abstract actor class providing streaming capabilities for persisted entities within a time window, utilizing MongoDB read journal, with configurable batch and timeout parameters.
